name: plan-keeper
description: Keeps a session's plan file honest: writes one from a task list of three or more steps, ticks a plan item once the task-list step of the same text is done, shows the plan's progress in a band above the prompt and a pane (/plan-keeper), and tells Claude when a task list ends with plan items still open

band.title: Plan band above the prompt
band.description: on: one row with the active plan, its progress and the next open item; off: no band, the pane and the ticks stay
